title: Arms Sales Notification
items_summary: Correction to the graphic for Transmittal No. 20-41, originally published in the August 26, 2020 notice (document 2020-18791, page 52576); the corrected graphic itself is not included in the text provided.
summary: This Defense Department notice corrects an earlier arms sales notification (Transmittal No. 20-41) published August 26, 2020, because the wrong graphic was printed in error. The replacement graphic is shown only as an image, so the country, equipment, values, and contractors cannot be determined from this text.
